entries.message: there is no component being set up. Hooks, `render()` and `mount()` belong to a component's setup, which runs synchronously from `init(this)` and ends at the first `await` — so after an `await` in setup, or later in a handler, there is no component to attach them to.
entries.fix: Await BEFORE `init(this)`; or create hooks and call `render()` before the first `await` and write what you await into state; or pass the element explicitly: `useEffect(fn, this)`.

entries.message: re-entered 50 times and was stopped — it writes state it also reads, and it runs synchronously on every change, so an unguarded write feeds itself.
entries.fix: Guard the write (`if (next !== state.x) state.x = next`), or use `useEffect`, which coalesces.
